lanes.summary: The diff wires the previously-unwired DUP-001 engine (scripts/check_pr_duplicate_patches.sh + scripts/lib/pr_dup_patches.py) into ci/sections.yml as two guard-tree steps (self-test on every event, cross-PR check only on pull_request), adds the roadmap entry, and adds a 21-mutant kill-set. I traced the exit-code paths (gh list failure, unshallow/fetch failure, engine rc mapping) and confirmed each refuses-unread with exit 2 rather than passing green, matching acceptance criterion 4. The self-test case table (23 rows, matching the comment's count) logically covers all four required case-table families (pure copy, copy+edit, cherry-pick-reworded; identical generated regen, whitespace-only) plus extra must-not-match rows (landed fixes, declared stacks) that don't contradict the ticket. The stacked-on exemption regex and its bidirectional check in find_dups() match criterion 2. Nothing in the diff weakens an existing gate — ci/sections.yml only adds lines.

findings.claim: For a commit-level duplicate, render() prints no file/hunk (tail is empty unless level=="hunk"), while the ticket's acceptance criterion 1 says the check must fail 'naming both PRs, both shas and the file + hunk' for a matching commit OR hunk patch-id.
findings.fix: Either relax the acceptance-criterion wording to hunk-level only, or extend the commit-level message to enumerate the commit's touched files.

lanes.summary: DUP-001 is wired into guard-tree exactly as PMAT-4536 specifies: the 23-row self-test case table runs on every event, the cross-PR check runs only on pull_request, and both gh-list and git-fetch failures exit 2 (never green), per the diff's explicit checks. The engine (scripts/lib/pr_dup_patches.py) computes commit- and hunk-level git patch-id --stable sets per PR, excludes generated paths/README-generated-blocks/whitespace-only hunks/already-landed content, and applies the stacked-on: #N exemption bidirectionally exactly once. Traced the trickier self-test rows by hand (stack-wrong-pr#, landed-fix dedup, detail-cap arithmetic, commit+hunk double-counting on 'pick') and each matches the code's actual behavior. Confirmed guard-tree runs inside the x86-main fat job which has permissions: write-all, so the added gh pr list / git fetch steps are not permission-starved. Found no test asserting the opposite of the ticket, no weakened gate, and no unrequested scope beyond the mutation harness (scripts/mutate_pr_dup_patches.sh), which is in-family with this epic's prior PRs.

findings.claim: landed_ids() runs `git log -p` over the full mb..base range on every (subject, other) pair; with the current 10-open-PR cap this is bounded, but the cost model is O(P) git-log-p calls per push event and isn't discussed as a scaling risk if the PR cap is ever relaxed.
findings.fix: Not a correctness defect against this ticket; worth a follow-up note if the max-10-open-PRs policy changes.
